title: Foundations of Proactive Agents: Principles, Technical Layers, and Proactivity-Gym
abstract: arXiv:2609.37267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proactive LLM agents can turn idle compute into useful support before users ask. Yet even correct work can misread user context, impose review costs, or undermine trust. This work proposes foundations for designing, realizing, and evaluating proactive LLM agents around three joint principles (3T): Task Capability, anticipating relevant needs and correctly performing useful work; Temporal Allocation, allocating compute according to resource availability and when results are needed; and Trust, sustaining users' confidence and appropriate reliance on the agent. We connect these objectives to a design space organized around five dimensions: task scope, anticipation horizon, activation trigger, processing timing, and intervention depth, and specify the situation and system modeling needed to support its choices, including user and environment representations, backbone LLMs, and agent harnesses. Lastly, we propose PROACTIVITY-GYM, a simulation

translated_title: 主动式智能体的基础：原则、技术层级与 Proactivity-Gym
translated_abstract: 主动式LLM智能体可以在用户提出请求之前，将闲置算力转化为有用的支持。然而，即使是正确的工作也可能误读用户上下文、增加审查成本或损害信任。本工作提出了围绕三大联合原则（3T）来设计、实现和评估主动式LLM智能体的基础：任务能力，即预见相关需求并正确完成有用的工作；时间分配，即根据资源可用性和结果所需的时间来分配算力；信任，即维持用户对智能体的信心以及适当的依赖程度。我们将这些目标与一个由五个维度构成的设计空间相联系：任务范围、预见范围、激活触发、处理时机和干预深度，并阐明了支持其选择所需的情境与系统建模，包括用户和环境表示、骨干LLM以及智能体框架。最后，我们提出了 PROACTIVITY-GYM，一个用于……的仿真平台。
tldr: 本文为主动式LLM智能体提出了设计基础，围绕任务能力、时间分配和信任三大原则（3T）构建了五维设计空间，并推出了用于评测主动性的仿真平台 Proactivity-Gym。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes foundations for proactive LLM agents through three principles (Task Capability, Temporal Allocation, Trust), a five-dimension design space, and the Proactivity-Gym simulation platform for evaluation.
